summary: Develop practical supervisory data, analytics, and SupTech planning skills. Explore the five-day course outline and enquire about training.
lede: SupTech for banking supervision applies digital methods to collect, validate, and analyze information from regulated institutions. For banking supervisors, prudential analysts, and supervisory technology specialists, the training covers data-quality checks, reporting analysis, dashboard design, and risk-indicator interpretation. Exercises include tracing data lineage, prioritizing review alerts, and planning digital workflows, with AI-assisted analysis considered alongside data controls and human review.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who handle bank supervision, prudential data, supervisory analytics, or technology-enabled oversight. It is designed for people who need to connect reporting data with practical supervisory decisions.
modules: SupTech Mandate and Basel Core Principles
AI and NLP for Supervisory Analysis
SupTech Governance and NIST AI RMF
prerequisites: Working familiarity with banking supervision, prudential reporting, or banking risk analysis is recommended. No programming is required. Practical dashboard exercises use Excel and Power BI; arrange access to the software available to you.
